purpose: Define a versioned, deterministic and fail-closed evidence template for qualified, deployment-specific EU AI Act risk-classification review. The template does not determine law, classify a real deployment, authorize processing, release, authority, or runtime operation.

authoritative_external_reference.classification_reference: Articles 5, 6, 50 and Annexes I and III; applicability and classification conclusions require qualified deployment-specific review.

verified_facts: Neural Brain is product- and domain-neutral and has no accepted scoped customer or domain integration.
The current repository does not establish a concrete deployment, intended deployment population, jurisdictional nexus, market availability, operating entity, or enabled use case.
The repository's protected Memory Core is an internal subsystem and cannot narrow the complete cognitive-system product boundary established by ADR-018.
unknown_facts_not_inferred: whether a specific deployment is within the scope of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
whether a concrete use is prohibited, high-risk, transparency-obligated, minimal-risk, exempt, or otherwise classified
actual intended purpose, users, affected persons, operational context, and sector
applicable Annex I or Annex III facts, substantial-modification facts, or an exemption
whether a concrete system may be placed on the market, put into service, deployed, released, or operated

assessment_template.assessment_unit: One immutable artifact version or digest, concrete proposed deployment, intended purpose, and authenticated Tenant, Area, and Project scope combination.
deterministic_review_order: Verify every required field, immutable artifact, scope binding, evidence freshness, accountable owner, qualified reviewer, review date, rationale, and reassessment trigger; any missing, unknown, stale, contradictory, or scope-mismatched fact is incomplete.
Review Article 5 prohibition evidence before every other candidate label; a qualified prohibition conclusion is a non-overridable release stop.
Review Article 6 and Annex I, then Annex III, for high-risk evidence; no exemption, control, approval, or favorable later assessment may silently replace missing facts.
Review Article 50 transparency evidence independently; it neither creates authority nor compensates for a prohibited, high-risk, unknown, or failed gate.

Record any remaining or minimal-risk candidate only after all preceding evidence is qualified and complete; the label is review output only and never an allow, legal, compliance, authority, deployment, or release outcome.

authority_boundary.template_is: a versioned governance and traceability input for separately governed qualified review
template_is_not: a legal opinion, applicability determination, or compliance certification
a classification of a real deployment or system
a finding of lawfulness or a determination of an exemption
a deployment, productive-use, or release approval
an authority grant, policy decision, human approval, or Security Floor override
an authenticated Tenant, Area, Project, Session, or principal context
a protected-state transition request, gate decision, or runtime capability enablement
an implementation, maturity, recognition, safety, or production-autonomy claim
authority_boundary.release_boundary: Only separately authorized release governance, qualified applicable review, and all Protected Control Plane, transition-gate, evaluation, recognition, and evidence requirements may decide a concrete deployment. This template cannot activate a runtime path.

current_blocker.unblock_condition: A concrete proposed deployment supplies every required field, immutable artifact and scope evidence, qualified review, rationale, controls, reassessment triggers, and independent release decision for separate governance evaluation.
current_blocker.next_step: Create one immutable assessment record per proposed deployment and reassess it whenever a mandatory trigger occurs before any deployment-specific release decision.
